Hello I wanted to get art again from you and wanted to get art of my character and my boyfriend's character!
The girl is a dream eater that protects dreamers from bad dreams! She meets the boy one day in the dream world. He's a human that for some reason is able to lucid dream and remember the girl in his dreams. They gradually fall in love with each other! I would love if the illustration had a romantic feeling to it and is something that you might see on a cover of a shoujo manga! The couple is very competitive with each other but very affectionate. Please note the guy's beauty marks on his nose and under his eye. Feel free to change the girl's hairstyle as you'd like! Thank you!
